description: This file defines a Java interface named MetadataBuilder, which provides a fluent API for building and manipulating Metadata objects. It includes methods to set, remove, and replace metadata fields with various data types (int, long, double, boolean, String, JsonValue, etc.), often with conditional predicates, and supports method chaining.

classes.name: MetadataBuilder
classes.description: A mutable builder for Metadata objects implementing a fluent API to set, remove, and manipulate metadata fields with support for conditional addition based on predicates.

methods.name: set(CharSequence key, int value, Predicate<JsonField>)
methods.description: Sets a new integer metadata value if the predicate evaluates to true.

methods.name: set(CharSequence key, int value)
methods.description: Sets a new integer metadata value unconditionally.

methods.name: set(CharSequence key, long value, Predicate<JsonField>)
methods.description: Sets a new long metadata value if the predicate evaluates to true.

methods.name: set(CharSequence key, long value)
methods.description: Sets a new long metadata value unconditionally.

methods.name: set(CharSequence key, double value, Predicate<JsonField>)
methods.description: Sets a new double metadata value if the predicate evaluates to true.

methods.name: set(CharSequence key, double value)
methods.description: Sets a new double metadata value unconditionally.

methods.name: set(CharSequence key, boolean value, Predicate<JsonField>)
methods.description: Sets a new boolean metadata value if the predicate evaluates to true.

methods.name: set(CharSequence key, boolean value)
methods.description: Sets a new boolean metadata value unconditionally.

methods.name: set(CharSequence key, @Nullable String value, Predicate<JsonField>)
methods.description: Sets a new String metadata value if the predicate evaluates to true.

methods.name: set(CharSequence key, @Nullable String value)
methods.description: Sets a new String metadata value unconditionally.

methods.name: set(CharSequence key, JsonValue value, Predicate<JsonField>)
methods.description: Sets a new JsonValue metadata if the predicate evaluates to true.

methods.name: set(CharSequence key, JsonValue value)
methods.description: Sets a new JsonValue metadata unconditionally.

methods.name: <T> set(JsonFieldDefinition<T> fieldDefinition, @Nullable T value, Predicate<JsonField>)
methods.description: Sets a metadata field based on a field definition with predicate condition.

methods.name: <T> set(final JsonFieldDefinition<T> fieldDefinition, @Nullable final T value)
methods.description: Sets a value for a field definition unconditionally.

methods.name: set(JsonField field, Predicate<JsonField> predicate)
methods.description: Sets a specified JsonField if the predicate evaluates to true.

methods.name: set(final JsonField field)
methods.description: Sets a specified JsonField unconditionally.

methods.name: remove(CharSequence key)
methods.description: Removes a metadata entry by key.

methods.name: remove(JsonFieldDefinition fieldDefinition)
methods.description: Removes a metadata entry by field definition.

methods.name: setAll(Iterable<JsonField> fields, Predicate<JsonField> predicate)
methods.description: Sets multiple fields with a predicate filter, replacing duplicates.

methods.name: setAll(final Iterable<JsonField> fields)
methods.description: Sets multiple fields unconditionally.

methods.name: removeAll()
methods.description: Removes all fields from the metadata.

methods.name: build()
methods.description: Creates the Metadata instance based on current builder configuration.
